name: Socrates & Plato
q: Necessity is the mother of invention
Wonder is the feeling of a philosopher
The beginning is the most important part
Justice is minding one's own business
At love's touch everyone becomes a poet
Music enters the soul's secret places
Astronomy compels the soul to look upward
Democracy is charming, full of disorder
Knowledge gained by force has no hold on the mind
The unexamined life is not worth living
Better to suffer wrong than do wrong
Education is the art of turning the eye of the soul toward the light
I know that I know nothing
He who steps out of the cave will at first be blinded by the sun
Philosophy is the practice of death
Refuse to rule and worse men rule you
